name: The District at Tustin Legacy
description: The District at Tustin Legacy is a vibrant open-air lifestyle center located in Tustin, California, offering a premier shopping and dining destination on the site of the former Marine Corps Air Station. This modern retail hub features a diverse mix of popular retailers, restaurants, entertainment venues, and services in a walkable, contemporary setting that serves the Orange County community.
summary: A modern open-air lifestyle center in Tustin offering diverse shopping, dining, and entertainment options on the historic Tustin Legacy site.
